newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys two January kerosene cargoes in tender.
newsitem.headline: India buys two January kerosene cargoes in tender.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought by tender 90,000 tonnes of superior kerosene in two cargoes for January delivery, traders said on Monday.
The cargoes, which are for delivery to the Indian east coast, were awarded to state-owned Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) and to Japanese trading house Itochu, traders said.
Itochu was awarded the cargo for delivery during January 1-10 at a premium of around $2.30 per barrel to MidEast spot quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
KPC's cargo was for delivery during January 21-31 at 75 cents per barrel over MidEast spot quotes on a free-on-board (fob) basis.
Traders said the two cargoes awarded were within last week's expectations.
The tender closed on December 5 and was valid until December 7.

In its last tender for December delivery, IOC awarded one 30,000-tonne cargo of kerosene to Dutch trader Vitol at a $1.59-premium to MidEst spot quotes c-and-f west coast, and one 45,000-tonne cargo to Japanese trader Tomen Corp at a $2.44-premium, c-and-f east coast.
